testcase.failure: Kubernetes 1.34 is out of Amazon EKS support (extended support ended 2027-12-02). Amazon EKS ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-12-02 and extended support on 2027-12-02. Extended support is on by default and billed per cluster-hour. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support. References: - https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/kubernetes-versions.html
